name: VARoleArbiterLinkedinTrendPost

custom.system_prompt: Priyanka and Farid, remote colleagues, disagree about a confident LinkedIn post predicting a sweeping industry trend. Priyanka is worried it might be true; Farid thinks the poster has no real authority to claim it. They ask Sigma to assess the claim and its source.

assistant.name: Sigma
assistant.tts_prompt: Neutral, clear headset audio, assesses claims specifically

sound_effects_config.prompt: Remote video call, light room tone, occasional keyboard clicks

initial_prompt: Generate a scene where Priyanka and Farid, on a quick remote call, discuss a confident LinkedIn post predicting a sweeping industry trend that would affect their jobs. Priyanka is genuinely a little worried it might be accurate; Farid is skeptical of the poster's actual authority or evidence. They ask Sigma to assess the claim and the credibility of its source. Keep every line short and natural.

user2.name: Farid
user2.tts_prompt: Calm, methodical, mildly dismissive of hype

variations.context: Remote colleagues disagreeing about a confident industry-trend prediction seen on LinkedIn

setting.relationship_dynamic: Colleagues who work well together, generally trust each other's read on things
setting.background: Priyanka saw the post an hour ago and can't quite shake it; Farid saw it too and shrugged it off
setting.conversation_style: Short, professional but genuine, over a quick call

scenario_template.topic: Priyanka raises the post and her worry that it might be accurate; Farid questions whether the poster has any real authority or evidence behind the claim. A few short exchanges.
scenario_template.note: Priyanka's worry should feel genuine, not just curious.

scenario_template.topic: Priyanka asks Sigma to assess the poster's credibility and the claim itself, addressing Sigma directly in one short line.
scenario_template.mood: Direct, wanting reassurance grounded in fact
scenario_template.note: e.g. 'Sigma, can you check if this person actually has grounds for this claim?'

scenario_template.topic: Sigma assesses the poster's apparent authority and whether the claim is corroborated elsewhere by more credible sources, stating a specific, honest read rather than flatly dismissing or confirming the prediction. One or two short sentences.
scenario_template.note: Predictions about the future are inherently uncertain — Sigma should be honest about that rather than pretending certainty either way.

scenario_template.topic: Priyanka feels somewhat better but not completely at ease, since the underlying trend question can't be fully settled; Farid is satisfied his skepticism held up but acknowledges Priyanka's concern wasn't unreasonable. Keep this realistic — a prediction can't be fully arbitrated like a past fact.
scenario_template.mood: Partially reassured, respectful of the underlying uncertainty
scenario_template.note: Avoid full closure given this concerns the future.

scenario_template.topic: They get back to their actual work, one short line each.

variations.context: Colleagues debate the potential obsolescence of their industry's tech

setting.relationship_dynamic: Colleagues who work well together, generally trust each other's read on things
setting.background: An article predicting the demise of a current industry standard
setting.conversation_style: Short, professional but genuine, over a quick call

scenario_template.topic: One of them expresses worry about the article's claim; the other doubts the author's expertise.
One of them asks Sigma for its assessment on the article and the author's credentials.
Sigma evaluates the author's background and checks for similar opinions from recognized experts.
One of them feels slightly relieved, though the future's still uncertain; the other finds their skepticism validated but sees the issue's complexity.
They shift focus back to their project tasks.

assistant.name: Sigma

Sigma assesses the poster's authority and corroboration, and is honest about residual uncertainty since this concerns the future
Every line is one or two short spoken sentences
The resolution is only partial — the anxious colleague feels better but not fully settled, which is realistic given the topic
assistant_behavior: Sigma assesses source authority and corroboration specifically
